final_wiki.Q-2626:
Q-2626: How many days are there from 2021-07-18 to 2021-10-19 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 93

Calculation: July has 31 days, so from 2021-07-18 to 2021-07-31 = 13 days. August = 31 days. September = 30 days. October 1-19 = 19 days. Total = 13 + 31 + 30 + 19 = 93 days.
